title: Plymouth GTX Engines by Year (1967–1971)
description: Every factory engine in the Plymouth GTX by year, 1967–1971: the 440 Super Commando standard engine, the 440 Six Barrel and the 426 Street Hemi.
intro: The GTX was Plymouth's premium mid-size muscle car, with a 440 as its standard engine and the 426 Street Hemi as the option. It was its own model from 1967 to 1971; from 1972 the GTX name continued as a 440 package on the Road Runner, listed on the Road Runner page.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
Every GTX came with a big block. The 440 Six Barrel, with three two-barrel carburetors, joined the list for 1970. The 1971 ratings are gross, with net figures in the notes where published.
